name: recency controls repeated weighted evictions
input: capacity ten with a hit before a five-weight insertion
test:
cache = WeightedLRUCache(10)
cache.put('a', 1, 3)
cache.put('b', 2, 3)
cache.put('c', 3, 4)
assert cache.get('a') == 1
cache.put('d', 4, 5)
assert cache.get('b') is None
assert cache.get('c') is None
assert cache.get('a') == 1
assert cache.get('d') == 4

name: replacing a key adjusts its old weight and keeps the replacement
input: an enlarged update after another key becomes most recent
test:
cache = WeightedLRUCache(8)
cache.put('a', 1, 3)
cache.put('b', 2, 3)
cache.put('c', 3, 2)
assert cache.get('b') == 2
cache.put('b', 20, 6)
assert cache.get('a') is None
assert cache.get('c') == 3
assert cache.get('b') == 20

name: invalid and oversized writes do not discard live entries
input: a capacity-eight cache with invalid weights and an oversized item
